statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Weekend closure leaves current Tail at 19% despite extreme geopolitical and energy stress.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; Tail is below the WATCH threshold while live NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the weekend closure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low as Gulf energy-route risk remains extreme
body: NQ futures are closed. A fresh Strait of Hormuz vessel strike, the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and Houthi pressure near Bab el-Mandeb keep Stress at 100%. These are major reopening-gap catalysts, but without observed one-way NQ structure they do not yet justify a higher current Tail classification.

lookbackSummary: Across the previous 24 UTC clock-hours, ChatGPT remained EA_ON with Tail at 19%. Stress rose from 96% to 100% as Middle East energy-route risk intensified while NQ moved into the weekend closure.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through most of the weekend closure, enters WATCH three hours before the Sunday 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, peaks at 24% around the reopen and first post-open hour, then eases conditionally if two-way price discovery and meaningful retracements emerge.

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed for the weekend, so no live price-path evidence can confirm persistent mean-reversion failure. The fresh Hormuz vessel strike and Saudi pipeline outage keep Stress at the ceiling while current Tail remains below WATCH.
